Graduate programs
Doctoral programs
Elevate your expertise at a premier Carnegie R1 research institution. KU’s doctoral programs are designed for innovators and scholars ready to lead in the academy, industry, and global society. Join a community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of knowledge through original research and expert practice
As a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities (AAU), KU provides an elite environment for doctoral study, supported by over $600 million in annual research expenditures. With 11 graduate programs ranked in the top 10 and nearly 50 in the top 50 among public universities nationwide, you will work alongside world-class faculty in 11 University Research Centers and more than 40 core laboratories.
Beyond the lab and classroom, you will join a vibrant community of over 5,000 graduate students and a global “Jayhawk” network of 300,000+ alumni. We are committed to your success through robust funding opportunities—including fellowships, GTAs, and GRAs—and comprehensive professional development resources to prepare you for high-impact careers in any sector.

Visit KU
Experience KU in person or virtually.
Seeing campus firsthand is one of the best ways to discover what makes the University of Kansas special. Explore academic buildings, residence halls, and student spaces while learning more about KU’s programs, campus life, and admissions process.
KU offers a variety of visit opportunities for prospective students and families, including campus tours, information sessions, and special events throughout the year. Whether you’re beginning your college search or narrowing down your options, visiting campus can help you imagine your future at KU.
Plan your visit to KU and see what it means to be a Jayhawk!
